topic: money can't fix what you won't face
lines: #You think more money will fix *everything.*
#But money is a *magnifier.*
It makes you more of what you *already* are.
#If you overspend on a small salary, you'll overspend on a *big* one.
If you hide from your bank account now, you'll hide from it *later.*
If you buy things to feel *better*, you'll just buy more expensive things.
#That's why some people earn a lot and still have *nothing.*
The money changed. The habits *didn't.*
A bigger salary just gave them a bigger *hole.*
#So before you chase more, look at what you're *running* from.
Is it boredom? *Stress?* Wanting to feel enough?
No amount of money fills a hole like *that.*
#Face it first.
Learn to sit with the feeling instead of *spending* it away.
Learn to look at your numbers without *fear.*
Build the habits while the money is still *small.*
#Because when it grows, and it can, you'll be *ready.*
You'll know how to keep it.
And how to make it *grow.*
#Fix the person. Then the money *follows.*
end: Save this for before your next big payday.

lines: MONEY IS A
MAGNIFIER.

post.title: More Money Won't Fix This
post.caption: Money is a magnifier. It makes you more of what you already are. 💰
post.first_comment: What do you usually buy when you're stressed? 👇
